column3: MT 42:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “a poem” is transliterated “A Maskil,” and “channels of water” is rendered “the water brooks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I passed along with the crowd” is rendered “I used to go along with the throng,” and NASB adds “in procession.”
“Bowed down” is rendered “in despair,” and “wait for God” as “Hope in God”; “the salvations of His presence” is rendered “For the help of His presence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Hermons” is rendered “the peaks of Hermon.”
Close to the Hebrew; “He commands” is rendered “will command.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with a shattering” is rendered “As a shattering.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the salvations of my face” is rendered “The help of my countenance.”
